description: 'Standardize the Day, Month and Year of Collection'
toc: true

```{r}
#| eval: false
barRoso::std_dates()
```

### Description

Cleans the `day`, `month` and `year` columns of herbarium records into whole
numbers, fixing the most common errors of these columns, and flags the dates
that could not be fixed.

### Details

The following changes are made:

- Numbers written with zeros or decimals become whole numbers, e.g. `"06"` and `"6.0"` into `6`, and zeros like `"0"` or `"00"`, used for unknown days and months, become `NA`.
- Months written as names or Roman numerals in English, Portuguese, Spanish or Latin become numbers, e.g. `"Jun"`, `"junho"`, `"junio"` and `"VI"` into `6`.
- Days and months in the wrong columns are swapped, which can only be known when the month is greater than 12 and the day is not, e.g. month `23` and day `7` into day `23` and month `7`.
- Missing days, months and years are taken from `eventDate`, e.g. `"1995-07-23"` or `"23/7/1995"`, when present.
- Values that are not possible dates become `NA`, e.g. month `14` with day `15`, day `31` in April, day `29` in February of a year that is not a leap year, or years before 1700 or after the current year.

The column `dateIssues` tells what was changed in each record, e.g.
`"day and month swapped"`, `"invalid month"`, `"invalid day"`, `"invalid year"`
or `"date from eventDate"`, and is `NA` for records without changes beyond the
number format.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| df | A data frame with herbarium records. |
| colname_day | Column name for the day of collection (default: `"day"`). |
| colname_month | Column name for the month of collection (default: `"month"`). |
| colname_year | Column name for the year of collection (default: `"year"`). |
| colname_eventDate | Column name for the date of collection, used to fill in missing days, months and years. Ignored when not in `df` (default: `"eventDate"`). |
| rm_original_column | Logical; if `FALSE`, the original columns are kept with the suffix `Original`, e.g. `monthOriginal` (default: `TRUE`). |

### Value

The data frame with the day, month and year as whole numbers, and the
column `dateIssues` after them.

### Examples

```r
df <- data.frame(day = c("07", "23", "00", "31", NA),
                 month = c("06", "7", "Jun", "IV", NA),
                 year = c("1995", "2001", "1987.0", "2010", NA),
                 eventDate = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, "1995-07-23"))
std_dates(df)
```
